entries.title: Psalms 106:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good! For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 106:2
segments: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? Who can declare all His praise?

entries.title: Psalms 106:3
segments: Blessed [are] those who keep justice, [And] he who does righteousness at all times!

entries.title: Psalms 106:4
segments: Remember me, O LORD, with the favor [You have toward] Your people; Oh, visit me with Your salvation,

entries.title: Psalms 106:5
segments: That I may see the benefit of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, That I may glory with Your inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:6
segments: ¶We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, We have done wickedly.

entries.title: Psalms 106:7
segments: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; They did not remember the multitude of Your mercies, But rebelled by the sea-the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:8
segments: Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake, That He might make His mighty power known.

entries.title: Psalms 106:9
segments: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it dried up; So He led them through the depths, As through the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 106:10
segments: He saved them from the hand of him who hated [them], And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 106:11
segments: The waters covered their enemies; There was not one of them left.

entries.title: Psalms 106:12
segments: Then they believed His words; They sang His praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:13
segments: ¶They soon forgot His works; They did not wait for His counsel,

entries.title: Psalms 106:14
segments: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tested God in the desert.

entries.title: Psalms 106:15
segments: And He gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.

entries.title: Psalms 106:16
segments: When they envied Moses in the camp, [And] Aaron the saint of the LORD,

entries.title: Psalms 106:17
segments: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, And covered the faction of Abiram.

entries.title: Psalms 106:18
segments: A fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 106:19
segments: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshiped the molded image.

entries.title: Psalms 106:20
segments: Thus they changed their glory Into the image of an ox that eats grass.

entries.title: Psalms 106:21
segments: They forgot God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt,

entries.title: Psalms 106:22
segments: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Awesome things by the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:23
segments: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach, To turn away His wrath, lest He destroy [them].

entries.title: Psalms 106:24
segments: Then they despised the pleasant land; They did not believe His word,

entries.title: Psalms 106:25
segments: But complained in their tents, [And] did not heed the voice of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 106:26
segments: Therefore He raised up His hand [in an oath] against them, To overthrow them in the wilderness,

entries.title: Psalms 106:27
segments: To overthrow their descendants among the nations, And to scatter them in the lands.

entries.title: Psalms 106:28
segments: They joined themselves also to Baal of Peor, And ate sacrifices made to the dead.

entries.title: Psalms 106:29
segments: Thus they provoked [Him] to anger with their deeds, And the plague broke out among them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:30
segments: Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, And the plague was stopped.

entries.title: Psalms 106:31
segments: And that was accounted to him for righteousness To all generations forevermore.

entries.title: Psalms 106:32
segments: They angered [Him] also at the waters of strife, So that it went ill with Moses on account of them;

entries.title: Psalms 106:33
segments: Because they rebelled against His Spirit, So that he spoke rashly with his lips.

entries.title: Psalms 106:34
segments: ¶They did not destroy the peoples, Concerning whom the LORD had commanded them,

entries.title: Psalms 106:35
segments: But they mingled with the Gentiles And learned their works;

entries.title: Psalms 106:36
segments: They served their idols, Which became a snare to them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:37
segments: They even sacrificed their sons And their daughters to demons,

entries.title: Psalms 106:38
segments: And shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and daughters, Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.

entries.title: Psalms 106:39
segments: Thus they were defiled by their own works, And played the harlot by their own deeds.

entries.title: Psalms 106:40
segments: Therefore the wrath of the LORD was kindled against His people, So that He abhorred His own inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:41
segments: And He gave them into the hand of the Gentiles, And those who hated them ruled over them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:42
segments: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.

entries.title: Psalms 106:43
segments: Many times He delivered them; But they rebelled in their counsel, And were brought low for their iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 106:44
segments: Nevertheless He regarded their affliction, When He heard their cry;

entries.title: Psalms 106:45
segments: And for their sake He remembered His covenant, And relented according to the multitude of His mercies.

entries.title: Psalms 106:46
segments: He also made them to be pitied By all those who carried them away captive.

entries.title: Psalms 106:47
segments: Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the Gentiles, To give thanks to Your holy name, To triumph in Your praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:48
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! And let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the LORD!
